nodes.line: The boards will hold. For a while./The east road is still Pell's worry.
nodes.note: the ditch is quiet and he is back to the work.

nodes.line: Quiet, then. I heard it stop./The pond can settle. You have my thanks.
Still down there. West gate, then/the stone room. You will hear it.
nodes.note: he has already pointed the way.

nodes.line: Calder. I keep the sluice./Something is living under the pond.
nodes.note: a working man, not a rumor.

nodes.line: Good. West, at the end of the street./Come back when the ditch is quiet.
nodes.note: he treats the promise as a job.

nodes.line: Not the barrow. West, through the trees./A stone room under the pond. One wolf.
nodes.note: he separates this job from Pell's hills.

nodes.line: The east road is Pell's worry./This ditch will still be here.
